targeting.title: n8n Sub-workflows: Pass Data, Return Output and Wait for Completion
targeting.metaTitle: n8n Sub-workflow Guide: Inputs, Output, Waiting
targeting.metaDescription: How n8n sub-workflows work: input modes, run once with all items vs each item, what the parent gets back, the wait option, publishing, caller policy and fixes.
targeting.excerpt: A source-verified guide to n8n sub-workflows: the three input data modes, how data crosses between parent and child, run once with all items versus each item, what the parent receives after loops and If nodes, the wait option, errors, caller policy, drafts versus published versions, and fixes.
targeting.keywords: n8n sub workflow, n8n execute workflow, n8n execute sub workflow, n8n sub workflow example, n8n pass data to sub workflow, n8n sub workflow output, n8n sub workflow return, n8n wait for sub workflow completion, n8n execute workflow trigger, n8n execute workflow not working
targeting.summary: Declare inputs in the child's trigger: undeclared fields are dropped on the way in, and the parent receives whatever the child's last node produced|Run once with all items for batches, Run once for each item for per record execution records; turning Wait for Sub-Workflow Completion off returns the parent's own input|Production runs use the child's published version and respect its caller policy, so publish the child and allow the parent before going live
targeting.author: Ali Rehman

overlap.note: No existing post covers sub-workflows; the Loop Over Items guide and the item linking post mention sub-workflows in passing and are linked from this article.

research.selection: The 6 November n8n seed set already showed 'n8n sub workflow' (10 suggestions: example, output, return, execute, call, create, wait for completion, pass data, same workflow) and 'n8n execute workflow' (10: trigger, node, with parameters, api, button, not working, trigger node, via api, output). Today's 30 seeds re-confirmed both plus 'n8n execute workflow trigger' (5). The competing Merge node cluster had only one strong head term with long tail seeds returning nothing and several dedicated blog guides already ranking in the DuckDuckGo sample, while the sub-workflow sample was dominated by official docs, community threads and a template, so this topic was chosen. It fits the existing n8n cluster and can be verified against the node and engine source.

competitorAndCaseReview.source: n8n Docs: Execute Sub-workflow and Execute Sub-workflow Trigger
competitorAndCaseReview.finding: Document source options, workflow inputs, mode, the wait option and the three input data modes, but not what the parent receives after loops or If nodes, the wait off output, publishing requirements or the error messages.

competitorAndCaseReview.source: n8n source ExecuteWorkflow.node.ts (versions 1 to 1.4) and ExecuteWorkflowTrigger.node.ts (versions 1 to 1.3) at the 2.46.6 tag
competitorAndCaseReview.finding: Source and mode parameters, Wait For Sub-Workflow Completion default true, each mode pairedItem per item, once mode pairedItem by position or fallback, wait off returns input items, continue on fail error items, first item expression hint, schema trimming with null fallback, Items to Return only below 1.2.

competitorAndCaseReview.source: n8n source sub-workflow-output.ts and workflow-execute-additional-data.ts at the 2.46.6 tag
competitorAndCaseReview.finding: Trigger 1.3 flattens main outputs into one; runs merged per branch from trigger 1.2 (fix for issue 9989 in 2.23.0); pinned data substitution in manual mode; draft for manual roots, published version otherwise with 'Workflow is not active and cannot be executed.'; timeout resolution; queue mode in the same worker; detached execution errors logged only.

competitorAndCaseReview.source: n8n source subworkflow-policy-checker.ts, subworkflow-policy-denial.error.ts, utils.ts, execution-lifecycle-hooks.ts
competitorAndCaseReview.finding: Caller policy values and default, exact denial message and descriptions, 'Missing node to start execution' message, error workflow dispatch for non manual sub-executions, binary data duplication to the parent.

competitorAndCaseReview.source: GitHub issue n8n-io/n8n#9989 and community thread 40842
competitorAndCaseReview.finding: Real reports of the last run only output and of parameters not arriving in the child; both are addressed in dedicated sections.
